title: bin_ambi_reduced_decode_fft2
description: `bin_ambi_reduced_decode_fft2` calculates a reduced set of HRTF spectra for higher-order ambisonic binaural decoding by combining HRIR data with columns of a pseudo-inverse decoder matrix and performing a real FFT. Configure the real and phantom loudspeaker positions, then send `calc_pinv` before using `calc_reduced` for each ambisonic channel.
